title: Downtown Riverfront Condo with Free Parking
description:
Escape to our immaculate 2-bedroom waterfront retreat in Nashville! Enjoy stunning Cumberland River views from this music-themed apartment that comfortably sleeps 6. Features a cozy fireplace, a fully equipped kitchen, and access to a waterfront pool. Perfectly located a short distance from downtown Nashville's vibrant Broadway nightlife. Your ideal Music City getaway awaits! *Pets are allowed. A $100 pet fee is required, for additional cleaning and maintenance of pet areas on the complex.

The space
Immerse yourself in the Music City spirit in our beautifully appointed waterfront apartment. The space is designed for comfort and relaxation, featuring a unique music-themed decor.

   Living Area: Relax by the cozy fireplace while enjoying serene views of the Cumberland River. The living room includes a comfortable queen sleeper sofa and a TV with a Blu-ray player for movie nights.
   Bedrooms: Two private bedrooms, each furnished with a plush queen bed and its own TV with a DVD player.
   Bathrooms: Two full bathrooms ensure privacy and convenience for all guests.
   Kitchen: A fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances awaits your culinary adventures. We provide a Keurig coffee maker with a selection of coffee and tea, plus a toaster for your morning convenience.
Capacity: The apartment comfortably accommodates up to six guests between the two bedrooms and the sleeper sofa.

Guest access
Guests will have private access to the entire two-bedroom apartment. In addition, you are welcome to enjoy all the fantastic community amenities, including:
* Covered parking that is included with your stay
* A sparkling waterfront swimming pool overlooking the Cumberland River
* private Indoor electric fireplace  
* A community fire pit for cozy evenings.
* A fully equipped gym / fitness center.
*  Convenient on-site laundry facilities.

Other things to note
The apartment is decorated with a special music theme to honor Nashville's rich history. We hope you enjoy the unique touches we've added to make your stay special. Please let us know if you are celebrating a special occasion!
